# Pinned runtime and test dependencies for the orchestrator CI jobs.
# Installed on Python 3.11 / linux before the editable Hermes checkout.
# Hermes itself is NOT in this file. Upstream blocks wheel builds and gates
# its pyproject dependencies behind python_version >= 3.14, so the workflow
# installs the pinned source checkout with pip install --no-deps -e.
# psutil is 7.2.2, not the 3.14-only 8.0.0 resolution.
# ruamel-yaml is 0.18.16 to match the upstream pin, not 0.18.17.
# Two contract spellings have no PyPI artifact and are corrected here:
# sniffio==1.3.1 (not 1.3.2; 1.3.1 is the published release and the v0.22.5 lock pin)
# uvloop==0.23.0 (not 0.23.1; 0.23.0 is the latest published release and has a cp311 wheel)
# pillow==12.3.0 (not 13.0.0; browser-harness==0.1.13 depends on pillow==12.3.0, and 13.0.0 does not resolve with it)
# These upstream v0.22.5 direct pins are required for the hermes console script
# and plugin host. They were not in the contract list; without them the suite
# fails while importing rich (and requests for bundled plugins):
# rich==14.3.3 requests==2.33.0 prompt_toolkit==3.0.52 snowballstemmer==3.1.1 PyJWT==2.15.1
# Transitives pinned so the 3.11 install does not float:
# charset-normalizer==3.5.2 markdown-it-py==4.2.0 mdurl==0.1.2
